answer: Frost work is scarce, so a key buys one graft slot instead of minting copies. It locks 44 units and draws row R=H(key||frost) mod 72 among the orchard terraces. Between minute (hash mod 16)+7 and +22 it seats a unique bud-stick from the ridge bench, then lowers a sap-temperature trace to the canyon weigh-hut. Two hut peers replay the trace and attest only if the serial is unused and H(stick||trace||key) matches the pre-commit. A late seat, reused stick, or off-band sap file burns 16 units and benches the key 8 epochs; a hut signing two rows in one night is fined 72 units and frozen 12 epochs.
